name: 3DFOX
summary: Czech filament shop in Liberec that says it produces its own filament, focused on the spoolless FOX REFILL line (PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA) advertised as Bambu AMS-compatible, with printed reusable spools sold separately and discounted overrun stock. Budget pricing (PLA refill 1 kg 339 CZK).

product_lines.name: FOX REFILL PLA
product_lines.notes: Spoolless refill, 1 kg and 3 kg; 339 CZK per 1 kg. Discounted overrun ('prebehy') stock also sold.

product_lines.name: FOX REFILL PETG
product_lines.notes: 289 CZK per 1 kg; overrun stock also sold.

additional_notes: Physical store in Liberec. SpoolmanDB PR #330 contains only two PLA REFILL entries. No relationships found; self-described own production.

provenance.conflicts: Own production in Liberec is the shop's uncorroborated claim; shop page names no company or ICO.
